body:
ACK and thanks. I will not undo clusterAssignments.

The acceptance bar is already in AmbiguousPlacementSuite (4/4 JVM):
1. Capacity: three episodic units, OtherEpisode marker, live classify.
2. Two-way ClusterContinuity holds both sides at the live 0.15 threshold; stay / return / unattached near-misses fail one or both sides.
3. Address masses equal the independently recomputed Ambiguous formula 0.4 Unresolved / 0.3 target / 0.3 other; near-misses differ by more than eps.
4. clusterAssignments (the same function induce now calls) reports PlacementBasis.Ambiguous on the two-way probe and ContinuityStay / ContinuityReturn / Unattached on the near-misses.

No threshold or arithmetic change. Still reserved, uncommitted, not on main.
